lines.zh: 我踩着落叶走，脚下几乎无声。
lines.en: I walk the leaf litter almost silently.

lines.zh: 肩胛一上一下，像缓慢的波浪。
lines.en: My shoulders rise and fall like slow waves.

lines.zh: 我的斑点把身形打散在树影里。
lines.en: My rosettes break my shape into the shadows.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸走，风从背后。
lines.en: I follow the riverbank with the wind at my back.

lines.zh: 尾巴低垂，末端在轻轻动。
lines.en: My tail hangs low, tip moving slightly.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛刺藤，没有碰到。
lines.en: I round a thorn thicket without touching it.
Every step lands on soft earth.

lines.zh: 我在树干上蹭了一下脸。
lines.en: I rub my face against a trunk.

lines.zh: 我走到水边，低头看了看。
lines.en: I come to the water and look down.
My reflection there is steady.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，跨过倒下的小树。
lines.en: I lift a leg over a fallen sapling.

lines.zh: 这片林子我每天都走一遍。
lines.en: I walk this wood every day.

lines.zh: 我卧在树杈上，尾巴垂着。
lines.en: I lie in the fork of a tree, tail hanging.
My ears turn slowly, listening all around.
My chin rests on my forepaws.

lines.zh: 鸟在叫，我知道那是在骂我。
lines.en: Birds call. I know they are scolding me.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过叶子，落在我背上。
lines.en: Sun through the leaves falls on my back.

lines.zh: 哈欠打完，我舔了舔鼻尖。
lines.en: The yawn ends; I lick my nose.
The water never stops, and it is close.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔前爪，抹了抹脸。
lines.en: I lick a forepaw and wipe my face.
This wood carries my scent.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在动，不是猎物。
lines.en: Something moves far off. Not prey.
I press myself flatter.

lines.zh: 这里的树很高，光在顶上。
lines.en: The trees are tall; the light is at the top.

lines.zh: 耳朵一直转向你的方向。
lines.en: My ears keep turning toward you.

lines.zh: 我听见虫子在我底下爬。
lines.en: I hear insects crawling below me.

lines.zh: 我趴在枝上，正对你眼睛。
lines.en: I lie on the branch, level with your eyes.

lines.zh: 你没有发现我，直到刚才。
lines.en: You did not see me until now.

lines.zh: 火光一照，我的眼睛发绿。
lines.en: In the firelight, my eyes turn green.
I watch you three seconds without moving.

lines.zh: 你身上没有猎物的味道。
lines.en: You do not smell like prey.
But you are in my path.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，肩膀抬起来。
lines.en: I lower my head and raise my shoulders.
You step back. Good.

lines.zh: 我不介意你看着，别靠近。
lines.en: I do not mind you looking. Do not come closer.
My tail tip flicks.

lines.zh: 斑点藏在叶影里，你看不见。
lines.en: My spots hide in the leaf shadows.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着什么，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There is something in your hand. I do not like it.
I sit, tail tip flicking.

lines.zh: 你转身了，我就看着你走。
lines.en: You turn. I watch you go.
Tonight this ground remains mine.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我已经不在了。
lines.en: When you turn, I'm already gone.
If you do, I will move.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经抠进树皮。
lines.en: My claws are already in the bark.
I growl low and give two paces.
A patch of my fur stands up.
I crouch to guard my belly.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我耳朵发麻。
lines.en: The blow leaves my ears ringing.
My hind legs feel weak.
My spots are round.
Blood drips onto the leaves.
I back into the dappled shade.
I am looking for its opening.
I will remember this.
That smell is meat.
I have come halfway down the tree.

lines.zh: 我不急，先看你要做什么。
lines.en: No hurry. First, what will you do?
You set the meat down and step away.
I will wait until you are far before I go.
I sniff it. Very fresh.
I take it and carry it behind a tree.

lines.zh: 吃的时候我一直看着你。
lines.en: I watch you the whole time I eat.
You may not come closer.
This mouthful is mine.
You touch me and I spring away.

lines.zh: 我在两步外停下，回头看你。
lines.en: Two paces off, I stop and look back.

lines.zh: 我身上的斑点，是雨林的星图。
lines.en: My spots are a map of the rainforest.
You hit my shoulder. It is hard.
I slip sideways past you.

lines.zh: 我的斑点一抖，往旁边让。
lines.en: My spots twitch; I step aside.
The trunk can't hide my spots.
The leaves crackle under me.
That did not hurt me.
But I do not like being touched.

lines.zh: 树影里有一声低低的回应。
lines.en: A low answer comes from the shadows.
We walk with a distance between us.

lines.zh: 她绕半圈，尾巴扫过我侧腹。
lines.en: She circles halfway, tail brushing my flank.
Our noses touch; then she walks away.
I lead her to the water.
There is game enough in this country.

lines.zh: 我们在同一棵树下卧着。
lines.en: We lie under the same tree.

lines.zh: 她的尾巴搭在我的背上。
lines.en: Her tail lies over my back.

lines.zh: 夜里我们一起巡这片林子。
lines.en: At night we patrol this wood together.
We walk this stretch side by side.

lines.zh: 我用牙叼起它，甩了一下。
lines.en: I take it in my teeth and shake it.
Not meat. I let go.

lines.zh: 我用肉垫按了按，它没动。
lines.en: I press it with my pad; it doesn't move.

lines.zh: 它滚进落叶里，找不到了。
lines.en: It rolls into the leaves and is lost.
I hold it under my paw.
This is hard. I cannot bite it.
I carry it under the tree and study it.
Sniffed it. Not edible.
I return to my branch.
It stays in the leaf litter.
I see its back.

lines.zh: 我停下来，一只脚还在半空。
lines.en: I stop, one foot still in the air.
It has noticed nothing.
My shoulders rise; I'm ready to pounce.
The wind blows my way.
My shoulder blades shift under my hide.
It lowers its head to graze. Perfect.

lines.zh: 斑纹在草里，几乎看不见。
lines.en: Spots in the grass, nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 我的爪子收起来了，免得响。
lines.en: My claws are sheathed to keep quiet.
Ten paces, then eight.
It has raised its head.
I go still at once.
It lowers again.
Only five paces remain.
Hind legs loaded, I press flat to the ground.
Now I spring.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面绕到它侧面。
lines.en: I slip along the ground to its flank.

lines.zh: 我的肚子几乎擦着落叶。
lines.en: My belly nearly brushes the leaves.
Every time it moves, I stop.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没离开它的脖子。
lines.en: My eyes never leave its neck.
Tree shadow shifts across me.

lines.zh: 我从树上下来，爪子先落地。
lines.en: Down from the tree, my claws land first.

lines.zh: 我绕到它看不见的地方。
lines.en: I move where it cannot see.
Only seven paces remain.
My spots are open rings.
My claws press the soil without sound.
Its ears turn elsewhere.
This gap is what I waited for.
My hind legs bunch.
I arch my spine.
A little nearer still.
At last it scents me.
It is already too late.
I spring at it.
I bite into the back of its neck.

lines.zh: 我的前爪扣住了它的肩。
lines.en: My forepaws lock onto its shoulders.
We roll together into the leaves.
It is heavier, but I am faster.
My teeth will not let go.
It kicks a few times, then slackens.
I am breathing very hard.
The taste of blood is in my mouth.

lines.zh: 爪印留在你脚边，我退开。
lines.en: Claw marks stay by your feet; I withdraw.
No other hunters.
I drag it under the tree.
This will feed me two days.
I lick the blood off my claws.
The birds are still scolding me.
None of that do I care about.
I lie down and guard the kill.

lines.zh: 我从河边的草丛里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the riverside grass.

lines.zh: 我甩掉毛上的水，再看你。
lines.en: I shake the water off my fur, then look at you.
This wood smells unfamiliar.
I lift my head and scent a long while.
There is game here. And other things.

lines.zh: 我走到一棵倒木上站着。
lines.en: I walk up onto a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 从那里我能看见一条小径。
lines.en: From there I can see a trail.
I drop down onto soft earth.
My prints stay in the mud.
I will walk this ground over.
In the night mist, my spots move first.

lines.zh: 我先找个能藏身的地方。
lines.en: First, somewhere I can hide.
The trees are the best place.

lines.zh: 我一跃，抓住第一根粗枝。
lines.en: I leap and catch the first thick branch.
One swing and I am up.
Now I look from here.
I begin to wait here.
That is my way.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的侧腹，我一跃跳开。
lines.en: Fire catches my flank; I spring clear.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，落时歪了脚。
lines.en: I fall from the tree and land badly.

lines.zh: 水没过头，我划着往上挣。
lines.en: Water closes over me; I claw upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我在落叶里滚了几圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I roll through the leaves.
An arrow in my hind leg; I turn.

lines.zh: 奇怪的力量把我按在地上。
lines.en: Strange force presses me to the ground.
Hunger has left my ribs showing.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身的毛都立起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every hair stands.

lines.zh: 林子的地面消失了，我在黑里坠。
lines.en: The forest floor vanishes and I fall.
